newsitem.title: CHINA: China VCD sales seen topping five million in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China VCD sales seen topping five million in 1997.

text.p: China sales of video compact disc (VCD) players are expected to top five million this year, making the country the world's top market for the video format, the Shanghai-based Business News said on Monday.
The VCD players had become one of the most popular household appliances in China along with colour television sets, refrigerators, washing machines and video cassette recorders, the newspaper said.

It quoted industrial analysts as saying annual sales of VCD players in China could reach 10 million by 2000, with the latest video disk format, digital video disc (DVD), unlikely to play a significant role in the China market for years to come.
China now had over 170 VCD producers, most of them small factories, the newspaper said. Imports accounted for only about a quarter of total sales.
